title: Raising the stakes for enterprise networks with AI modernization
headline: Enterprise networks face AI modernization and data sovereignty challenges
summary: Agentic AI generates significantly more network traffic than human workers, placing severe strain on enterprise networks. As AI inference shifts to on-premises or near-premises infrastructure due to latency demands, organisations must rethink their network architectures. Additionally, international regulations regarding data sovereignty and sovereign AI are creating complex infrastructure challenges for global enterprises.
why_it_matters: Organisations must adapt their network infrastructure and architectural governance to handle intense AI workloads and comply with strict data sovereignty laws.

quotes.text: Tasks conducted by AI agents generate an estimated 450% more network traffic than the same tasks done by human workers.
Regulators worldwide are passing laws requiring data and AI processing to remain within national borders.

classification.significance_reason: Highlights enterprise infrastructure and regulatory challenges driven by AI workloads and data sovereignty laws.
